› why does TestAdmission flake under -race?
✓ approved by codex, muse against 3f9a1c2e · 2 reviews
  The test shares one budget ledger across subtests and runs them in parallel, so two reservations
  race on the same turn id. Give each subtest its own ledger, or drop t.Parallel() from the table
  loop.

› make the dispatch retry loop stop on context cancel
✓ approved by codex, muse after 2 revisions against 81b04d7a · 6 reviews
  The loop now selects on ctx.Done() before each attempt and before each backoff sleep, and
  returns ctx.Err() without counting a retry.

› can we drop the second repair attempt for malformed verdicts?
! INCOMPLETE, not approved · rounds_exhausted · 2 open blocks · 6 reviews

  its branch can be deleted.
